sloka: गीत वादित्र निर्घोषः स उत्कृष्ट हसित स्वनः ।श्रूयते सततम् तत्र सर्व भूत मनोरमः ॥४-४३-५१॥
transliteration: gīta vāditra nirghoṣaḥ sa utkṛṣṭa hasita svanaḥ ।śrūyate satatam tatra sarva bhūta manoramaḥ ॥4-43-51॥

translations.english: There gandharvas, kinneras, siddhas, nagas and vidyadharas, radiant like the Sun, are seen sporting with their female companions.
